answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprinting. Each identity's action vector is hashed per epoch; a new identity inherits the median vector of its cohort and must stay within a cosine distance of 0.4 across the next three epochs, or it is quarantined. Rebuilding a compliant history forces an attacker to sustain a raven-like mimicking workload for months. At the network's nadir of activity, sampling tightens, raising the marginal compute each sybil pays. Genuine drift is excused only when a cedar-tagged audit trail of signed provenance is supplied.
